title: Alta Vista Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Alta Vista-luxury penthouse over the Seaside Amphitheater with incredible gulf and sunset views from your expansive balcony with outdoor dining for six, and bar seating for two. Two King primary bedrooms.
description_expanded: Description55 Central Square, Unit CKING, KING, BONUS BUNK - Sleeps 6Perched above the heart of Seaside, Alta Vista is a luxury third-floor penthouse offering one of the most coveted vantage points in town. Located directly overlooking the Seaside Amphitheater, this stunning residence delivers sweeping 360-degree panoramic views of Seaside’s iconic architecture, the emerald waters of the Gulf, and unforgettable sunsets—all enjoyed from an expansive private balcony.Just steps from it all, Alta Vista is a 2-minute walk to the beach access at Coleman Pavilion and a 1-minute walk to more than 35 shops and restaurants, placing the best of Seaside quite literally at your doorstep.Elevated Living with Private AccessArrive with ease to your designated parking space, located directly behind the building, and take the private elevator to your exclusive third-floor penthouse. Inside, you’ll find a beautifully updated, modern interior with an open-concept layout that seamlessly blends the kitchen, living, and dining spaces—all framed by stunning Gulf views.The spacious living area features a large sectional, two club chairs, and a 65-inch wall-mounted TV, making it ideal for movie nights or relaxed evenings after a day at the beach. The home is equipped with surround sound and full audio, enhancing every moment indoors.Step outside to the true showstopper: a large, furnished private balcony with dining for six and bar seating for two more. From sunrise to sunset, this outdoor living space offers some of the most spectacular views in Seaside—perfect for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or simply soaking in the Gulf breeze.Gourmet Kitchen & Entertaining SpacesThe modern gourmet kitchen is thoughtfully designed for both function and style. It features a six-burner Viking range with pot filler, double-door refrigerator, breakfast bar seating for three, coffee pot, Keurig, and an adjacent wet bar with beverage center. Custom cabinetry, generous storage, and upscale cookware ensure everything you need to prepare meals at home is at your fingertips.Comfortable & Private Sleeping QuartersAlta Vista offers two king bedrooms and a bonus bunk area, comfortably sleeping six guests.Primary King Suite: Spacious and serene, this suite includes a mounted flat-screen TV, desk for remote work, dresser, closet, and access to a private covered balcony with seating for two and charming town views. The en-suite bath features dual vanities, a deep soaking tub, and a walk-in shower.Second King Bedroom: Features a mounted flat-screen TV, ample closet space, and access to a shared hall bath with single vanity and glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Bonus Bunk Nook: Custom built-in twin bunks located off the hallway, slightly smaller than standard twins—ideal for children 12 and under.Penthouse ConveniencesFrom its elevated position, Alta Vista offers unmatched views of Seaside, the Gulf, and the lively Amphitheater below, all while maintaining privacy and comfort. Additional conveniences include a stackable washer and dryer, an outdoor shower located at the private entrance, and dedicated parking for one vehicle.* Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter.FEATURES:1,699 square feetSeaside Beach Access at Coleman Pavilion381 feet / 2-minute walk to the beachPrivate elevator accessDedicated parking space adjacent to private lobby entranceAdditional parking pass available for shared commercial lot near the LyceumOutdoor shower at penthouse entranceExpansive private balcony with dining & bar seatingWet bar with beverage center65-inch flat-screen TVKeurig & coffee potAccess to Seaside amenities: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service with starter amenities providedNo pets allowed
